entities.name: Onnik Dinkjian

entities.summary: Onnik Dinkjian is a French-born American-Armenian musician and singer. He is the father of Ara Dinkjian and has appeared with his son as well as other Armenian musicians such as Roupen Altiparmakian playing oud.
